## Hands-on 3 – Reproducing a recorded result {#hands-on-3-reproduce-the-recorded-result .smaller}

::: {.small}
- **Task 3**, in the webR workspace or in the working script of the IDE workspace: choose **C6HJR**, **KQXUE** or **018OL**
- In the webR workspace each analyst has a few cells of its own, one step to a cell, with gaps to fill, hints and full solutions; in the working script the three are written out
- In the browser, one cell of 018OL installs two packages for mixed models, a download of about 32 MB
:::

::: {.fragment}
When you have your value, compare it with the value on record.
:::

::: notes
Open Task 3, in the webR workspace or in the working script of the IDE workspace, and choose one of the three analysts. In the webR workspace each analyst has a few cells of its own, one step to a cell, and every gap has a hint and a fully worked solution underneath, since the task is about the number at the end rather than about typing. In the working script the three analyses are written out, so read each line as you run it. If you choose 018OL in the browser, one of its cells first downloads the packages for mixed models. [advance] Compare your value with the value on record, and if you finish early, take a second analyst.
:::
